source_refs.note: Osmoconformers: a main subheading of 13.2.1 Osmoregulators and Osmoconformers, its own page (owner 2026-11-04); PDF 4-4.

blocks.text: Osmoconformers woh janwar hain jo apni jism ki rutoobaton ki osmotic concentration (pani mein ghule maddon ki miqdar) ko apne mahol ke barabar rehne dete hain. Yeh apne jism mein pani aur ghule maddon ki miqdar khud qaim nahin rakh sakte. Is liye bahar ka pani badalne se in ke andar ki miqdar bhi badal jati hai, aur yeh hamesha apne mahol ke saath isotonic (barabar gaarhe) rehte hain. Aise janwar aam taur par aisi jagah milte hain jahan namak ki miqdar kafi had tak ek jaisi rehti hai, jaise samundar. Misalen: tamam samundari invertebrates (be-reerh janwar), kuch meethe pani ke invertebrates, aur kuch samundari vertebrates (reerh wale janwar) jaise hagfishes, sharks aur rays.
